The Long Article About Things

This is the introductory paragraph of a substantial article. It contains several sentences about a topic of some real interest, and it goes on for multiple lines so that the extraction libraries can recognize it as the main content of the page. Trafilatura uses several heuristics to find the article body, including paragraph length and text density.

The second paragraph continues the discussion, adding context and detail. We talk about a related topic and then expand on the implications.

A Section Heading

Here we have another paragraph under a subheading. The structure of the article is clear: an introduction, then sections each with their own heading and supporting paragraphs. This is the kind of layout trafilatura is built to recognize.

One final paragraph to give the extractor plenty of signal to work with. The more substantial the body text, the more confident the extractor can be that this is the article and not boilerplate navigation chrome.
